headline: Warden Thrust Sweeps Nevish Line as Marban Hollow Shifts
war_summary: Since the morning dispatch, a dramatic Warden offensive has overhauled the western front along the Nevish Line, smashing the prior four-to-four deadlock to secure seven of eight strategic strongholds amidst relentless clashes at Princefal and Grief Mother. In Marban Hollow, Warden forces extended their counter-thrust around Checkpoint Bua, swinging the sector's balance to four Warden bastions, three Colonial positions, and one neutral ruin. Eastward in the Weathered Expanse, Warden troops recaptured a second base from the ruins, leaving five strongholds in Colonial possession and two unoccupied amid persistent fighting across Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance. Contest flared anew in the Linn of Mercy, logging five rapid engagements at Lathair even as the board maintained its nine-to-one Colonial advantage. Skirmishes at Faden Point kept Kuura Strand active under a steady four-to-two Colonial ledger, while Godcrofts and Callahan's Passage lapsed into comparative lull. At the center, Dead Lands endured punishing attrition with nearly seven hundred fresh casualties over two hours along an unyielding line.
